annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it tells viewers that, after joining Forsage, they should promote it and build a network to increase profit. U.S. authorities charged the platform's founders over an alleged recruitment-based crypto pyramid and Ponzi scheme; the clip presents network expansion as the way to earn from that named system, not as criticism or scam reporting.
